kartu.deskripsi: Makna kata, wacana, dan penyusunan gagasan
Bilangan, aljabar, geometri, data, dan peluang
Menemukan, memahami, menilai, dan merefleksi informasi
Memahami, menilai, dan menyintesis teks berbahasa Inggris

tujuan.pengantar: Setelah mempelajari materi ini, peserta mampu:

blok.teks: Local authorities have announced a plan to restore a neglected public square. The proposal includes shade trees, accessible walkways, and seating for older residents. These improvements are encouraging, particularly in a neighborhood with few comfortable outdoor spaces. Yet the announcement offers little detail about maintenance funding, and earlier renovations in the area deteriorated after routine care was reduced. The council should publish a realistic upkeep plan and consult residents before construction begins. A well-designed square could improve everyday life, but enthusiasm for a new project should not replace careful planning.

Residents had previously complained that the square offered little shelter from the sun and that uneven paving made movement difficult for wheelchair users. The proposal appears to respond to these specific problems. The writer acknowledges that the design could make the square more welcoming, but also recalls a nearby playground that was temporarily improved and then closed when repairs became unaffordable.

In the writer's view, public consultation should address not only which features residents want but also who will maintain them and how costs will be shared. The writer does not argue against restoration. Instead, the central concern is that an attractive opening ceremony should not be mistaken for a durable public benefit.

soal.teks: Complete the following sentence using exactly one word or number from the passage. Do not use synonyms.
These improvements are ______, particularly in a neighborhood with few comfortable outdoor spaces.

pembahasan.teks: Pada materi Tone, Attitude, and Author's Viewpoint, encouraging merupakan pilihan kata evaluatif yang menunjukkan penulis melihat potensi positif dari rencana pemulihan ruang publik. Sikap keseluruhan penulis tetap berhati-hati karena persoalan perawatan. Namun, soal ini tidak meminta interpretasi nada yang bisa dijawab dengan berbagai sinonim; jawaban encouraging diambil langsung dari kalimat dalam bacaan.

soal.teks: Which statement best represents the author's viewpoint?

opsi.A: Restoration should focus on visual design rather than future maintenance planning.
opsi.B: Residents should determine the square's design only after construction is complete.
opsi.C: Previous renovation failures make every new public-space project unjustified.
opsi.D: The council should begin construction before resolving maintenance funding questions.
opsi.E: Restoration could benefit residents if maintenance and consultation are planned.

pembahasan.teks: Soal meminta sudut pandang penulis, bukan sekadar nada emosional. Penulis menilai peneduhan, jalur akses, dan tempat duduk sebagai perkembangan yang menjanjikan, tetapi khawatir pada anggaran perawatan dan pengalaman renovasi sebelumnya. Ia meminta rencana upkeep dan konsultasi penduduk sebelum konstruksi. Karena itu, opsi E benar: dukungannya bersyarat pada perencanaan dan partisipasi. Dalam Tone, Attitude, and Author's Viewpoint, sikap cautious berbeda dari penolakan total terhadap proyek.
A salah karena perawatan jangka panjang merupakan fokus utama kekhawatiran penulis.
B salah karena konsultasi dianjurkan sebelum pelaksanaan, bukan sesudah konstruksi.
C salah karena penulis tidak menolak semua proyek baru; ia mengakui manfaat potensial.
D salah karena penulis ingin pendanaan dan pengelolaan dibahas sebelum pembangunan.

soal.teks: Determine whether each statement is true or false according to the passage.

baris: The author views the planned improvements as potentially beneficial.
The author expresses concern about maintenance funding.
The writer fully endorses construction without further consultation.
The tone is entirely hostile toward public green space.

pembahasan.teks: Soal ini meminta peserta mengategorikan empat pernyataan sebagai Benar atau Salah berdasarkan stimulus. Dalam materi Tone, Attitude, and Author's Viewpoint, penilaian dilakukan dengan membandingkan cakupan setiap pernyataan dengan fakta, hubungan informasi, dan batasan yang dinyatakan dalam bacaan. Nomor 1 benar: penulis mengakui potensi manfaat. Nomor 2 benar: kekurangan informasi pendanaan disebut sebagai masalah. Nomor 3 salah: konsultasi justru diminta sebelum pembangunan. Nomor 4 salah: nada tidak hostile karena ada apresiasi terhadap manfaat ruang publik. Evaluasi mengharuskan membaca keseluruhan posisi penulis, bukan memilih tone hanya dari satu kata negatif.
Pernyataan 1 (Benar): disebut encouraging dan could improve everyday life.
Pernyataan 4 (Salah): penulis mendukung manfaat proyek dengan syarat.
